column1: # replay-layout.tsv -- the bytes of the engine records a demo recording carries that it does not
# record as plain values (research/notes/tadr-port/demo-recorder-completeness.md): the unit and
# player records, a unit's mover and order nodes, and a player's PlayerInfo. Every other byte of a
# record is recorded whole and must replay exactly, so each row is a loosening, and adding one is
# the owner's decision (CLAUDE.md, *Simulation changes stay replayable*). The feature grid's cells and
# the wreck pool's records are carried too (demo-recorder-skirmish-slice.md, S3a): a record of the
# pool is laid out by its def, a 3DO feature's (wreck3do) or a GAF feature's (wreckgaf), and one
# whose def is outside the defs is imaged as a 3DO one.
# tools/replay-layout-gen.py says what the columns and classes mean and generates
# inc/tagpu_replay_layout.h from this file; the build fails when the two disagree.
# The rows start from the stock savers, the engine's own inventory of a record: 0x4876C0 writes a
# unit's 0xB8-byte save record, 0x43DD70 its mover, 0x43A970 each order node and 0x4662F0 a
# player's keys. The engine map's *The unit and player
# records, byte by byte* has every field, its writers and the evidence; `writers` names function
# entries. The level load's fill 0x4854A0 zeroes every unit record and the players' reset
# 0x4644D0 every player record; neither is repeated in the rows.

column8: evidence

DISASSEMBLED: the 0x2F-byte mover (constructor 0x43DC00), made by the creates when the type's def+0x22F is 1 and freed and nulled by the destructor (0x486DBF), so it lives exactly as long as its unit; the saver writes it through 0x43DD70, the restore through 0x43DE30. Recorded by the mover record, as the tail of the unit's image, whose dword here is 1 when the unit has one
DISASSEMBLED: weapon slot 1 (slots at +0x04, stride 0x1C) holds the def's weapon1 *(def+0x1EE), set once by 0x49E070 from the creates; the saver writes the weapon's ID byte [ptr]+0x10A
DISASSEMBLED: weapon slot 2 (slots at +0x04, stride 0x1C) holds the def's weapon2 *(def+0x1F2), set once by 0x49E070 from the creates; the saver writes the weapon's ID byte [ptr]+0x10A
DISASSEMBLED: weapon slot 3 (slots at +0x04, stride 0x1C) holds the def's weapon3 *(def+0x1F6), set once by 0x49E070 from the creates; the saver writes the weapon's ID byte [ptr]+0x10A

DISASSEMBLED: the head of the order list, written through its address by the list functions and the restore (0x48754F); the saver writes each order through 0x43A970. Recorded by the order record: the list as its nodes' images, in order

DISASSEMBLED: the second order list, for orders whose descriptor carries 0x40000 (BuildWeapon, SelfDestruct); MEASURED NULL in all 65 996 PRS1 records. Recorded by the order record, as the main list is

DISASSEMBLED: the sort bucket, chosen by the restamp 0x47CC30 from the position at that moment and nulled at death by 0x47CBD0; MEASURED not a function of the position (7.0 % of 65 934 units sat in a neighbouring bucket)
DISASSEMBLED: the carrier, set and cleared by the attach 0x48AB70 (0x48AC70, 0x48ACD2)
DISASSEMBLED: the first carried unit; the attach pushes at the front (0x48AC82) and the unloads take the head (0x406960, 0x4115C7)

DISASSEMBLED: the next carried unit of the carrier while +0x86 is set, else the next unit in the sort bucket; both orders reach the simulation (the bucket walk 0x47E890 feeds RepairPatrol's pick by the simulation RNG, 0x405A89 -> 0x4B6C30)
DISASSEMBLED: *(main+0x1439B) + 0x249 * [+0xA6], written by 0x485A40 (0x485A75); the level fill and the destructor store the table's base; the saver writes the type's name
DISASSEMBLED: the owning player's record, set per slot of each player's block at level load (0x485887, 0x485902), NULL in slot 0; a capture creates a new unit instead (0x488570)
DISASSEMBLED: the COB object (vtable 0x4FD698), made by 0x485D40 and freed by the destructor; the saver writes its state through 0x4B1EC0

DISASSEMBLED: the model instance, whose +0xC points back to the unit (0x485E14); its piece pose is simulation state (the fire point 0x43E240) and the stock save carries it inside the COB save 0x4B1EC0

DISASSEMBLED: the head of the chain of unit references (vtable 0x4FD754) that point at this unit, rebuilt by linking every restored reference through 0x489690; MEASURED all 770 chains equal the captured references

DISASSEMBLED: +0x30 of the resource object at +0xBC, the owner's player record, set by 0x401070 from the create (0x485D0A); the saver writes the object's first 0x30 bytes only; MEASURED equal to +0x96 in all 65 996 records
DISASSEMBLED: the last attacker, read with no alive test (the kill credit 0x4869CA), so its slot is kept when that unit is dead; the saver writes 0 for a dead one
DISASSEMBLED: the selection, written by the selection code for the controlled or viewed player (main+0x2A42, +0x2A43)
DISASSEMBLED: two marks the selection code sets and its sweeps clear (0x48BD00, 0x48D846); read only by the next-unit cycle 0x48D4D0 (0x48D511, 0x48D56D), which is UI
DISASSEMBLED: the build menu's page (bit 22 has one, bits 23-25 which, 0x41B200); read by the menu code only

DISASSEMBLED: the transport ID, the DirectPlay ID in a network game and the seat in a skirmish (0x464381), -1 when free; the dispatcher 0x453D40 routes on it, and the death path turns a killer's player index into it and back (0x44FFD0 at 0x486625, 0x44FE40 at 0x486782); the recording carries it as the player's key
DISASSEMBLED: GetTickCount through 0x4B6340 at the join (0x451356)
DISASSEMBLED: a number the network host assigns, read by 0x4532B7 [INFERRED: the machine that hosts the record]
DISASSEMBLED: the messages of one receive pass, zeroed for all players at each call of the dispatcher (0x453D78)
DISASSEMBLED: a GetTickCount difference (0x456743)
DISASSEMBLED: the owner peer's GameTime carried by the 0x2C (0x48B769, 0x48B963); the pacing 0x495230 slows the game by it, so a puppet host stamps its own
DISASSEMBLED: GetTickCount through 0x4B6340 at each receive (0x454856), read by the timeouts 0x453C20, 0x453839
DISASSEMBLED: load progress, read only by the load wait 0x497CE0
DISASSEMBLED: session flags each machine sets on its own record, read only by 0x451345 and the network level setup 0x49723B

DISASSEMBLED: the 0xB9-byte PlayerInfo, allocated by the constructor 0x463BE0 and kept across the reset, and never freed for main's eleven records (the destructor 0x463C40 runs only on stack-local ones, 0x454538, 0x454607); the saver writes its +0x95 (Side) and +0x96 (Logo). Recorded by the info record, as the tail of the player's image, whose dword here is 1 when the record has one
DISASSEMBLED: the first slot of the player's block, set at level load (0x4858BD); MEASURED begin + 0x118 * [+0x6F] in all 960 PRS1 records
DISASSEMBLED: the last slot of the player's block, inclusive (0x4858E0); MEASURED begin + 0x118 * [+0x71]

DISASSEMBLED: the controller as the local peer sees it (2 local AI, 3 remote, 1 local human [INFERRED]); it changes mid-game (the console's AI toggle 0x4161F0 flips 1 and 2 through 0x463C60, a leave writes 0), so the recording carries each change; a puppet host holds 3 for every puppet
DISASSEMBLED: the AI object, made by the init 0x464700 (0x4648C1), run by the players phase (0x46502A)
DISASSEMBLED: the control-group table (10 entries of 0x20), rebuildable from each unit's +0xAC through 0x480250
DISASSEMBLED: the sight counters, one byte per 32-wu cell, re-stamped every tick (0x4827B0) and rebuilt whole by 0x4816A0
DISASSEMBLED: the sight grid's width, height and length, computed at level load from main+0x14233 and +0x14237; the length bounds 0x4816A0's fill of this process's grid, so it is never written
DISASSEMBLED: a 0x34-byte resource accumulator (init 0x401070) whose +0x30 points back to the player

DISASSEMBLED: DisplayTimer, a GameTime deadline: DrawGameScreen 0x468CF0 adds 30 while it is below GameTime and then refreshes the resource bar's rates (0x468F73..0x468F87), for the viewed record only; a seek sets it to GameTime, as the init does (0x464765)

DISASSEMBLED: the movement class object, chosen once by the constructor from the owner's +0x73 as the local game sees it and def+0x241 bit 11 (0x43DC48..0x43DD08): a local ground (0x44F010) or air (0x4907E0) class, or for a type-3 owner a ground (0x44F570) or air (0x490940) proxy, so a puppet host holds a proxy where the recording machine held a local class; freed by 0x43DD10 in the destructor (0x486DB1); the stock save skips it

DISASSEMBLED: *(def+0x1B6), the type's movement class, an entry of the static table 0x512358..0x512758 (0x20 each) that the type loader resolves through 0x440420 (0x42CD0C, 0x42CD29); written only by the constructor (0x43DC45), so the create recomputes it from the recorded type; read by the pathfinder (0x40E63F, 0x40ED4A); the stock save skips it

DISASSEMBLED: what the allocator left in the 0x2F-byte block the creates allocate (0x4860C6, 0x4862DA; MEM_Alloc 0x4B4F10, not zeroed): the constructor keeps them (0x43DC25..0x43DC2F), every writer of the byte masks them out (0x43D27D, 0x43D91C, 0x43DED3, 0x48ACE9, 0x44F605), and nothing reads them

DISASSEMBLED: when set, the node's destructor 0x43A1F0 calls the order's handler with event 2 (0x43A1F5..0x43A21A), owner code: BuildingBuild's event 2 deals its unfinished frame 30 000 (0x402701). The stores found that set it are in BuildingBuild (0x4028B5, 0x402922, 0x402AE6), MobileBuild (0x403F0C), VTOL_Pickup (0x411464), AirStrike (0x412526, 0x4125BB) and AirToGround (0x412CE3); the handlers' other stores of the mask were not audited bit by bit
DISASSEMBLED: the unit whose list holds the node, stored by the linkers (0x43AD3A, 0x438564); the playback's linker writes it
DISASSEMBLED: the unit reference's target, set through 0x489690 (which refuses NULL or a unit with +0xA6 = 0) and cleared at the target's death (0x489740 from 0x486D75)

DISASSEMBLED: the next reference in the target's +0xA2 chain, rebuilt when the target is set through 0x489690; the chain's order changes nothing, both of its walkers only OR a bit into the owners' +0x4E (0x489740, 0x4897B0)
DISASSEMBLED: the reference's owner, the node itself (0x43A137, 0x43A44F)
DISASSEMBLED: the sprite resolver's last-seen x of the target under the viewing player's sight (0x4397AF), read only by 0x439740: the viewing machine's own state
DISASSEMBLED: the last-seen z (0x4397BC), as seenx

DISASSEMBLED: when clear, the node's destructor runs 0x489800(owner, 3) (0x43A2AB..0x43A2B9), which resets the weapon slots' targets and starts TargetCleared, owner code; set on removal for a node that is not the head (13 sites, 0x4384D7..0x43BC3C) and by six descriptors (flags 0x10060)
DISASSEMBLED: seenx and seenz are valid (0x4397C5), the viewing machine's own state as they are
DISASSEMBLED: set by 0x438590 after it starts StartBuilding (0x4385E3); the node's destructor then starts and broadcasts StopBuilding (0x43A21E..0x43A25D), owner code
DISASSEMBLED: the next node of the list; the list's image records the nodes in order

DISASSEMBLED: the handler's own object, installed by 0x4388D0, 0x438930, 0x438A00 or 0x438AD0 and deleted by the node's destructor (0x43A264..0x43A2A2) or the next install, so it lives while the node holds it for a unit of a type 1 or 2 owner; each install hands it to the unit's movement class (slot 1), and a type-3 owner's air proxy (vtable 0x4FD9E0, slot 1 0x44EF90) deletes it itself (0x490A10, and its destructor 0x4909A0); recorded as its class code, the saver's own record of it (0x43A970); MEASURED: a copied pointer faulted at 0x43A2A2
